description: Change of Use from Use class E(c)(iii) (any other services which it is appropriate to provide in a commercial, business or service locality) to Use Class E(b)(for the sale of food and drink principally to visiting members of the public where consumption of that food and drink is mostly undertaken on the premises,)  (both use classes fall within Use Class E - no material change of use) with installation of extractor flue at rear.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:CSE/001 REVISION NO_01 (Existing and Proposed Ground Floor Plan),CSE/002 REVISION NO_01 (Existing and Proposed Front Elevations),CSE/003 REVISION NO_01 (Existing and Proposed Rear Elevations),CSE/004 REVISION NO_01 (Existing Side Elevation A),CSE/005 REVISION NO_01 (Proposed Side Elevation A),CSE/006 REVISION NO_01 (Existing Side Elevation B),CSE/007 REVISION NO_01 (Proposed Side Elevation B),CSE/008 REVISION NO_01 (Existing Section AA),CSE/009 REVISION NO_01 (Proposed Section AA),CSE/010 REVISION NO_01 (Existing and Proposed Roof Plan),CSE/011 REVISION NO_01 (Existing Block Plan),CSE/012 REVISION NO_01 (Proposed Block Plan),CSE/013 REVISION NO_01 (Location Plan),Flood Risk Assessment (Dated December 2025),Revised Planning Statement and Heritage Statement,Noise Impact Assessment (Dated 17th November 2025),EMAQ+ Odour Assessment (Dated 17th November 2025),Carbon Filter Bag Specifications,GigaBox centrifugal fans Specifications,Metal Cased Discarbs Specifications.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings and documents, all external parts of the kitchen extract flue hereby permitted shall be painted matt black and shall be permanently retained in this form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and setting of the Enfield Town Conservation Area.

Prior to first use of the kitchen extract flue hereby approved, the noise and vibration control systems as detailed within the Noise Impact Assessment (Dated 17th November 2025), must be fully installed. The noise and vibration control systems must thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To restrict impacts of noise disturbance and to safeguard the residential amenities of surrounding residential occupants.

Prior to first use of the kitchen extract flue hereby approved, the odour control systems as detailed within the EMAQ+ Odour Assessment (Dated 17th November 2025), must be fully installed. The odour control systems must thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To prevent the expulsion of harmful odours, and to safeguard the residential amenities of surrounding residential occupants.
